messages:
alex_support: FYI Finsera says some customer objects that were put into PRESERVE mode last week still show up in regular search results and are not being tombstoned even though their custom deletion window expired yesterday. Can we confirm whether the preserve->delete transition ran?

maria_oncall: looping in infra. do we have an audit entry for retention.pause/resume for this org id? customer org=finsera-prod, policy_id=pol_8yW2

ken_infra: I don't see a retention.resume event in audit for that org between 2026-01-18 and 2026-01-20. Only a retention.pause at 2026-01-15 03:12 UTC. That could explain why the deletion scanner skipped those objects.

alex_support: customer insists they asked to resume preservation on 2026-01-19 via the UI. they provided two example object ids: obj_9a2f, obj_7d4b. they also included a screenshot of the UI toggling preserve->off.

maria_oncall: can we repro with cli to check object metadata + tombstone status? ken, can you run quick checks?

ken_infra: running 1) metadata API 2) storage listing 3) index search for obj_9a2f. attaching commands I ran:

```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  "https://api.redwood-inference.internal/v1/objects/obj_9a2f/metadata" | jq .
```

response:
```
{"id":"obj_9a2f","org":"finsera-prod","retention":{"mode":"preserve","expires_at":"2026-01-17T03:12:00Z"},"tombstone":false}
```

index search (shows still returned by search): `search?q=id:obj_9a2f` -> returned in hits.

ken_infra: storage shows object present, KMS decrypt ok (no decrypt errors). So object wasn't tombstoned. No resume audit event -> likely UI toggle didn't persist or webhook failed to the control-plane.

emma_legal: hold on — customer legal opened a temporary litigation hold last month. if legal hold was re-applied it would supersede resume. do we have a legal-hold flag for this org?

ken_infra: checked legal_hold table: finsera-prod has no active legal_hold rows. last legal hold closed 2025-12-12.

maria_oncall: next step: check control-plane write logs for policy updates around 2026-01-19 01:00-06:00 UTC and the UI telemetry. if the UI showed success but write failed, we'll have missing audit events. ken, can you grep the control-plane logs and the write-audit pipeline?

ken_infra: grep shows a 502 error from the policy-service at 2026-01-19T01:07:23Z for org finsera-prod, request id req_22b7. The UI got a 200 due to frontend retry logic, but backend never emitted audit event due to the write failing before the audit hook. I've opened an internal ticket: IS-5482.

sre-bot: reconcile-job started for org=finsera-prod, policy=pol_8yW2, run_id=rec_20260120_0001

ken_infra: reconcile job will attempt to compare desired retention state vs. actual objects and enqueue tombstone operations for objects that should be deleted. I queued obj_9a2f and obj_7d4b manually to the delete queue.

maria_oncall: ETA for tombstone to be applied?

ken_infra: delete queue backlog at the moment. With current throughput, these queued tombstones should process within ~6 hours. I'll prioritize this org and watch for any KMS errors.

emma_legal: please confirm that audit trail will capture the manual tombstone action and that we won't lose the preservation history — legal will need records for chain-of-custody.

ken_infra: manual tombstone action will write audit event retention.force_delete with actor=infra-batch. We will also attach the original retention.pause event and the policy-service failure request id to the audit metadata.

alex_support: I'll tell Finsera: we found a backend write error on 2026-01-19 that prevented the UI change from persisting; we've enqueued the affected objects for immediate tombstoning and legal/audit trail will be preserved. will update once tombstones applied. :thumbsup:

maria_oncall: small follow-ups for postmortem: 1) why did frontend return 200 on failing write? 2) ensure policy-service emits audit event before replying 200 OR add a retry/confirm path for the UI. 3) alerting: surface policy-service 5xxs tied to org-specific writes as P1.

ken_infra: noted. creating follow-up ops task OPS-7643 to add end-to-end write confirmation and audit hook ordering.

alex_support: Customer update sent. Closing loop after reconcile job finishes.

sre-bot: reconcile-job finished for org=finsera-prod, run_id=rec_20260120_0001, status=partial_success, tombstones_applied=2

maria_oncall: confirmed both objects now show tombstone=true and are no longer returned in search. marking thread resolved, will file incident if similar events surface.
